svg.title: Where a piecewise function is continuous
svg.desc: The graph of f(x) = x/2 + 1 for x < 1 and f(x) = 1/(3 − x) for x ≥ 1, x not 3. The left piece is a line ending at an open circle at (1, 1.5). The right piece starts at a closed dot at (1, 0.5), rises without bound as x approaches 3 from the left, and comes up from below on the other side of the dashed vertical asymptote x = 3. Brackets under the axis mark the intervals where f is continuous: (−∞, 1), [1, 3) and (3, ∞).
